fixtures.name: basic-predefined
fixtures.description: Scripts outside any asmdef and outside special folders compile into Assembly-CSharp.

fixtures.name: compile-error
fixtures.description: A misspelled identifier reports CS0103 at its exact file, line and column.

fixtures.name: asmdef-ref-by-name
fixtures.description: An asmdef reference by assembly name makes the referenced assembly's types visible.

fixtures.name: asmdef-ref-by-guid
fixtures.description: An asmdef reference of the form GUID:<hex> resolves through the referenced asmdef's .meta GUID.

fixtures.name: asmdef-missing-reference
fixtures.description: An asmdef reference that resolves to nothing is warning UCL1001 and is dropped, so the code that needs it fails with CS0246.

fixtures.name: asmdef-circular
fixtures.description: Two asmdefs that reference each other are error UCL1002 and neither is compiled.

fixtures.name: asmdef-include-platforms
fixtures.description: An asmdef with includePlatforms [Android] is compiled only in the Android player; the editor and other players leave it out.

fixtures.name: asmdef-exclude-platforms
fixtures.description: An asmdef with excludePlatforms [WebGL] is left out of the WebGL player but compiled in the editor (even with WebGL active) and in other players.

fixtures.name: editor-folder-depth
fixtures.description: A script in a folder named Editor at any depth (Assets/Tools/Level/Editor) goes to Assembly-CSharp-Editor, which a player build leaves out.

fixtures.name: plugins-firstpass
fixtures.description: Scripts under Assets/Plugins compile into Assembly-CSharp-firstpass, which Assembly-CSharp sees but which cannot see Assembly-CSharp.

fixtures.name: plugins-editor-firstpass
fixtures.description: Editor scripts under Assets/Plugins/Editor compile into Assembly-CSharp-Editor-firstpass, which sees Assembly-CSharp-firstpass and is seen by Assembly-CSharp-Editor; players leave both editor assemblies out.

fixtures.name: standard-assets-firstpass
fixtures.description: Scripts under "Assets/Standard Assets" compile into Assembly-CSharp-firstpass, which Assembly-CSharp references.

fixtures.name: define-constraints-true
fixtures.description: An asmdef whose defineConstraints hold (ENABLE_TELEMETRY from the Standalone scriptingDefineSymbols) is compiled; on Android the constraint fails and it is left out.

fixtures.name: define-constraints-false
fixtures.description: An asmdef whose defineConstraints fail (ENABLE_CLOUD_SAVE is only defined for Android) is not compiled and its consumer gets CS0246.

fixtures.name: define-constraints-or-not
fixtures.description: defineConstraints ["UNITY_EDITOR || DEVELOPMENT_BUILD", "!DISABLE_DEBUG_TOOLS"]: the assembly exists in the editor and in development players, except where DISABLE_DEBUG_TOOLS is defined (Android).

fixtures.name: version-defines-hit
fixtures.description: A versionDefines entry on com.unity.modules.physics with expression 1.0.0 (x >= 1.0.0) defines GAME_CAMERA_PHYSICS because the module resolves to 1.0.0.

fixtures.name: version-defines-miss
fixtures.description: A versionDefines range [2.0.0,3.0.0) on an installed package at 1.4.0 does not define SAVEGAME_2, so the 1.x code path compiles.

fixtures.name: version-defines-unity
fixtures.description: versionDefines with resource "Unity" compare against the editor version: 6000.3 (x >= 6000.3) holds only on 6000.3.2f1, [6000.0,6000.1) only on 6000.0.30f1.

fixtures.name: override-references-dll

fixtures.name: override-references-missing
fixtures.description: An asmdef lists Newtonsoft.Json.dll in precompiledReferences but no such DLL exists: Unity skips the name without a message (UCL1004 is info), and the code that needs it fails with CS0246 and CS0103.

fixtures.name: no-engine-references
fixtures.description: An asmdef with noEngineReferences compiles without UnityEngine and UnityEditor DLLs, so MonoBehaviour is CS0246.

fixtures.name: unsafe-allowed
fixtures.description: An asmdef with allowUnsafeCode: true compiles unsafe code without CS0227.

fixtures.name: unsafe-refused
fixtures.description: Unsafe code in a predefined assembly without Player Settings allowUnsafeCode is CS0227.

fixtures.name: csc-rsp-define
fixtures.description: A -define: in Assets/csc.rsp defines the symbol for the predefined assemblies.

fixtures.name: csc-rsp-nowarn

fixtures.name: csc-rsp-asmdef-local

fixtures.name: csc-rsp-warnaserror

fixtures.name: analyzer-scoped

fixtures.name: scripting-defines-per-platform

fixtures.name: unity-minor-paths

fixtures.name: package-scoped-registry

fixtures.name: api-compat-netfx
fixtures.description: G1. ProjectSettings in the Editor's real shape (wrapped values before the API keys) with Standalone at level 3 (.NET Framework) and editorAssembliesCompatibilityLevel 2, and the System.Memory and System.Buffers NuGet DLLs in Assets/Plugins. Standalone cells compile against unity-4.8-api, where the DLLs' Span<T> and ArrayPool<T> are the only ones; Android keeps the default level 6 (.NET Standard 2.1), which also defines them: CS0433 and CS0121, as in the Editor.

fixtures.name: plugin-native
fixtures.description: G2. An unmanaged x86-64 DLL (no CLI header) under Assets/ThirdParty/Plugins/x86_64 with an ordinary PluginImporter .meta (Editor and Win64 enabled). Unity never passes a native DLL to the compiler: no reference, no CS0009; the script calls it through DllImport.

fixtures.name: precompiled-reference-absent
fixtures.description: G3. An embedded package's Editor-only code-gen asmdef (overrideReferences) lists Unity.IL2CPP.dll, which is in neither the project nor the package, and Vendor.Math.dll, which is. Unity skips a listed name it cannot find without a message and compiles the assembly: ucl reports UCL1004 as info only, references Vendor.Math, and the cell is clean.

fixtures.name: facade-system-runtime
fixtures.description: G4. A package DLL compiled against the System.Runtime contract (Vendor.Contracts) in a project with Standalone at level 3. unity-4.8-api/Facades/System.Runtime.dll forwards its types to mscorlib; under .NET Standard (Android) the NetStandard shims' System.Runtime.dll forwards them to netstandard. No CS0012 in either profile.

fixtures.name: realistic-netfx-nuget
fixtures.description: G1-G4 together, shaped like the maintainer's real project: Standalone level 3, editor level 2, System.Memory, System.Buffers and a System.Runtime-built package DLL in Assets/Plugins, a native x86-64 plugin, and an embedded package whose code-gen asmdef lists a precompiled reference that does not exist. Clean in every cell where the Editor compiles it clean (all Standalone cells, editor and player, development or not).

fixtures.name: test-editmode
fixtures.description: ucl test (phase B): an EditMode suite with pure tests, TestCase and TestCaseSource, a SetUpFixture, cases behind #if UNITY_5_3_OR_NEWER, UNITY_EDITOR and NET_UNITY_4_8, engine-touching tests (needs-unity), [UnityTest], LogAssert, [UnityPlatform] and [RequiresPlayMode] (unity-only), a real failure, ignored, explicit and inconclusive cases, CoreCLR/Mono divergences, a legacy optionalUnityReferences test assembly and a Play Mode assembly. The test framework and com.unity.ext.nunit are embedded stand-ins; nunit.framework.dll is NUnit 3.14.0 from NuGet. 'tests' lists every case ucl test must report, in order, with its category.
